row.title: A failed step after the work is not a beat, and must not discard the work
row.body: The scout workflow ran on 2026-11-24; scout and rnd finished, the idea-bank step exited 1 and the commit step was skipped, so a week of findings was lost while the clock read ticking. The commit step now runs unless cancelled, the scout clock beats only on a successful run and is restarted after 1.5 intervals, and the watchdog no longer skips restarts under the Actions budget pause when the repository is public.

title: A failed step after the work is not a beat, and must not discard the work
